Visas required
To Cuban citizens who have not been granted temporary residence or permanent settlement in the Republic of Serbia, or who have not been previously issued a D visa (visa for a longer stay), the following documents must be presented upon entry into the Republic of Serbia, in addition to meeting the general entry conditions:
A notarized invitation letter from the person the foreigner is visiting in the Republic of Serbia, or proof of a paid reservation at a hotel or other accommodation facility in the Republic of Serbia;
Proof of possessing sufficient funds for subsistence during the planned period of stay in the Republic of Serbia. Sufficient funds are considered to be an amount of 50 EUR per day of stay, and proof of sufficient funds can be in the form of cash in the specified amount or a bank account statement;
Proof of paid health insurance in the Republic of Serbia, or possession of a health insurance policy for the period of stay in the Republic of Serbia, covering medical expenses of at least 20,000 EUR; and
Proof of a paid return airline ticket with a fixed return date to the country of origin or previous point of entry.
